business_profile.business_overview: Rongin Interior Solution is a trusted interior design company in Dhaka serving homes, offices, showrooms, hotels, resorts, cafés, and restaurants across all of Bangladesh. They position around three pillars — workplaces that inspire success, hospitality spaces guests never forget, and homes that tell your story — and emphasize modern design, smart space planning, custom furniture, budget-friendly service, and timely handover. Their intake is a single phone line (01677139529) with a 'Call now for a free consultation' CTA, and they maintain an extensive SEO footprint with dedicated service-area pages for dozens of Bangladeshi locations (Sylhet, Tangail, Uttara, Wari, Tongi, and many more).

business_profile.competitive_position: Rongin competes with BD INTERIOR (ISO-certified, corporate roster) and many smaller Dhaka studios. Their strength is breadth — residential, commercial, and hospitality across the whole country with strong SEO. Their weakness is intake: one phone line. Competitors offering online booking and instant WhatsApp responses capture the enquiries Rongin misses, especially after hours.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With nationwide coverage and three high-value segments (home, office, hospitality), Rongin likely fields dozens of enquiries weekly. If phone-only intake misses even 20% (busy line, after hours, no callback), that's several lost projects per month at BDT 300K-1M each = BDT 5-10M+ in annual leakage. An AI agent answering every enquiry instantly and booking consultations recovers this directly.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI enquiry agent on website + WhatsApp that answers every prospect instantly, qualifies project type (home/office/hospitality), location, and budget, and books a free consultation.
2. After-hours capture agent that logs and qualifies enquiries that arrive outside business hours, then schedules callbacks.
3. Multi-location routing that tags each enquiry by service area so the right team follows up.
4. Follow-up agent that nurtures prospects who enquire but don't book immediately.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A café owner in Sylhet finds Rongin's 'interior design in Sylhet' page at 9pm and wants a quote for a 1,200 SFT space. Instead of hitting a dead phone line, the AI agent replies in seconds: 'For a 1,200 SFT café, most clients invest BDT 8-15 lakh. I can have a designer call you — here are 3 slots tomorrow.' The owner books 11am. Rongin wakes up to a qualified, booked hospitality lead they would have otherwise lost to the night.
